verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a ready-built, white-label hosted UI for AIS and PIS flows, with pre-built institution selection and consent screens. The docs say no frontend engineering is needed and that SCA and bank redirects are handled automatically, and the resulting consent token is then used to retrieve the user's accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the server-side session-creation step and how the token is returned to the app after the hosted flow, confirmation of an embeddable widget rather than a redirect-only hosted page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
